name: Clena
source:
You play as Clena, your normal everyday girl. After being fired from her job, she stumbles upon a circus filled with animals. She now lives together with them as a janitor, while secretly tasked to pursue one of the boys.
Food: Expensive Food
Interest: Animals, Cleaning & Eating
